job.command:
stardev
ln -s starsim_herwig6_filter.C starsim.C
#-------------------------------------------- # Random seed #-------------------------------------------- set seed_temp=`od -vAn -N4 -tu4 < /dev/urandom` set myseed=`expr ${seed_temp} % 100000`
#-------------------------------------------- # pTHatMin scan -- herwig6, unmodified Herwig 6 defaults # 40 jobs for each of 10 pT values (400 total, 500 events/job = 200k events) #-------------------------------------------- set ptlist = (62 64 66 68 70 72 74 76 78 80)
@ pt_group = ${JOBINDEX} / 40 @ run_number = ${JOBINDEX} % 40 @ list_index = ${pt_group} + 1
set ptcut = ${ptlist[$list_index]}
echo "========================================" echo "Tune = herwig6_default" echo "JOBINDEX = ${JOBINDEX}" echo "Run number = ${run_number}" echo "Random seed = ${myseed}" echo "ptHatMin = ${ptcut} GeV" echo "========================================"
mkdir -p /star/data01/pwg/seanp/tunes/herwig6_default
echo "Starting detector simulation..."
root4star -q -b starsim.C\(500,${myseed},${ptcut}\)
echo "Finished detector simulation." echo "" echo "Starting reconstruction..."
root4star -b -q 'runSimBfc.C(500,1,"herwig6")' root4star -b -q 'readMudst.C(0,1,"herwig6.MuDst.root")'
echo "Finished reconstruction."
mv SimpleTree_mudst.root /star/data01/pwg/seanp/tunes/herwig6_default/SimpleTree_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root
